title: Record the Teacher's Score
notes: The teacher's own mark for the written answer, out of 100. It is compared with VivDuck's rubric score (score_before). Saving a score clears the session from the review queue. Returns the updated class agreement.

request.note: Fair grade. The overflow point deserved partial credit.

errors.meaning: Score missing or not between 0 and 100

body.error: Score must be a whole number from 0 to 100.
